annotations.title: Who has recorded, who is still out, and how long is left.

description: Returns who is in with their name and relationship, how many voices, videos and written messages have come in, how many carried a photo, who the organiser is still waiting on, the days left before collecting stops, and next: the day to chase the ones still out and the day to close the book.
name: book_status
title: Who has recorded, who is still out, and how long is left.
